reason: Preserves the existing PUBLIC EXECUTE contract required by 15 existing PUBLIC-targeted RLS policy dependencies. End-user JWT calls bind targets to auth.uid() outside any trigger context; same-file REVOKE precedes the explicit reviewed grant. Catalog policy-caller and caller-scope pgTAP provide positive and negative controls.
